patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: It came out of nowhere — sudden, severe pain low on my right side, and I threw up from how bad it is. It comes in these awful waves.
clinical.presentationShort: 22yo F ? sudden severe unilateral pelvic pain with vomiting and marked right adnexal tenderness; pain 9/10.
clinical.presentationLong: 22-year-old female with sudden severe right-sided pelvic pain that comes in waves, repeated vomiting, and marked right adnexal tenderness. She is tachycardic and rates the pain 9/10.

diagnosis.disposition: Acute → pelvic ultrasound with Doppler, OB/GYN for detorsion; the ovary dies without prompt surgery.
diagnosis.why: The ovary's testicular-torsion cousin: sudden, severe, one-sided, vomiting. Ultrasound + surgery before it necroses.
diagnosis.redFlag: Sudden severe unilateral pelvic pain + vomiting = torsion (the ovary's version of testicular torsion).

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: doubled over, clutching her lower right abdomen
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: an asian 22-year-old woman, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: doubled over, both hands clutching her lower right abdomen. Expression: grimacing and nauseated. Clearly visible: a doubled-over posture with hands pressed to the lower abdomen. No text, no logos.
